headline: El Niño threatens harvest, could slow 2027 GDP growth by up to 1.1%​
summary: An IFPRI analysis warns Ethiopia's 2027 growth could be up to 1.1% slower than projected as El Niño rainfall shortages hit agriculture, incomes and food security. Elevated global fuel prices add to the risk.
why: Agriculture is a large part of Ethiopia's economy and employment, so rainfall shocks feed directly into output, household incomes and food prices. The International Food Policy Research Institute is a Washington-based research body.
